stem_book: The equation (cos p − 1)x² + (cos p)x + sin p = 0 where x is a variable, has real roots. Then the interval of p may be (a) (0, 2π) (b) (−π, 0) (c) (−π/2, π/2) (d) (0, π)
work: D = cos²p − 4(cos p − 1)sin p ≥ 0 whenever sin p ≥ 0 (cos p − 1 ≤ 0) ⇒ (0, π) works; p = 3π/2, −π/2 give D = −4 < 0, killing (a), (b), (c)
